text:
maria: quick sync on migrating service tokens to short-lived ephemeral tokens for background jobs to reduce blast radius

lee: we already have ephemeral user tokens for interactive flows, but background jobs still use long-lived service keys.

devon: main blocker is credential refresh complexity in our worker framework and some 3rd-party libs that assume stable creds.

maria: tradeoff: security vs operational friction. proposal: phased rollout. 1) allowlist vulnerable job types and rotate manually; 2) provide SDK helper that auto-refreshes ephemeral token via token-exchange; 3) make ephemeral tokens default for new jobs in 2 quarters.

sec-ci: security-scan: dependency check failed for 23 workers that use old secret-store patterns https://ci.internal/scan/4260002222

lee: SDK helper needs to support backoff jitter and local caching to avoid stampeding token refresh.
devon: also add fallback to signed cookies for older libraries that can't do header auth easily.

maria: action items: SDK helper spec (devon), inventory of workers (lee), communication + runbook (maria). timeline 4-6 weeks for pilot.

sec-ci: ticket AUTH-4325 created for pilot tracking https://tickets.internal/AUTH-4325

maria: sweet, let's reconvene next week with inventory.
